signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that the platform enables sellers to appoint Gumroad as their non-exclusive reseller of digital products that Gumroad deems eligible for resale through the services.
subject_exact: Gumroad legal role as non-exclusive reseller of eligible digital products on behalf of sellers
extraction_notes: Terms of Service effective 2025-01-01. 'Non-exclusive' and 'deems eligible' qualifiers preserved. Establishes Gumroad's merchant of record legal structure.
